visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brightly lit indoor studio set resembling a traditional Chinese wedding banquet hall. A groom in a black suit with a red flower corsage and a bride in a white off-the-shoulder wedding dress (actually a man in drag) hold red wine glasses, preparing for a toast. A woman with a curly wig and tweed jacket stands beside them against a backdrop of red panels with large gold 'Double Happiness' symbols. (2) The camera focuses on a pair of legs in white high heels walking briskly down a red-carpeted hallway. A person in a pink cardigan and beige top (another man in drag) enters the scene with a confrontational expression, wearing large sparkling earrings. (3) A series of close-up reaction shots of the groom looking panicked and the two brides looking defiant. The intruder in pink adjusts her hair and makes sharp hand gestures while talking. (4) The visuals shift to a stylized parody of an anime battle. Red digital sashes and glowing aura effects appear around the characters. Sections of the screen are humorously pixelated as characters strike dramatic poses. (5) An explosion effect occurs with a rapid montage of the characters being physically thrown back by an invisible force, accompanied by graphic overlays and motion blur to simulate high-impact comedy. (6) The scene transitions to professional promotional footage for a mobile game. Celebrities like Zhong Xinling and members of Power Station appear in various costumes (ancient, futuristic, casual) against green-screen backgrounds. Cutaway shots show 2D animated game footage featuring stone age and ancient Egyptian themes. (7) A man wearing a baseball cap and green shirt speaks to the camera in a plain studio. Finally, a person in a brown dress (drag) opens a door and sighs in relief before another character appears behind them.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Atmospheric chatter and rhythmic clapping set the scene of a celebratory banquet. Background music is lighthearted and optimistic. A clinking sound of glasses is heard followed by appreciative male laughter. (2) A sudden sharp violin stinger occurs. A male voice yells a sharp question in a commanding tone. This triggers a series of heavy, rhythmic high-heel footsteps on a hard floor. (3) Intense dialogue begins with a mock-dramatic tone. Deep male voices use exaggerated feminine inflections. BGM shifts to a suspenseful orchestral string section with a fast tempo. (4) A loud, synthesized power-up 'whoosh' and energy charging effect. A male voice shouts 'Bankai' with high vocal strain. BGM becomes a fast-tempo, bass-heavy electronic track. (5) Multiple loud percussive 'boom' effects representing explosions. Chaotic cartoon-style sliding and crashing sound effects. Vocals become high-pitched shouts of panic and surprise. (6) Audio transitions to a high-energy commercial segment. A professional male narrator speaks clearly with a very fast speech rate. Upbeat electronic pop music with a strong synth beat plays continuously. Digital 'chime' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate gameplay mentions. (7) Narrative returns to the comedy sketch with a door latch clicking and a creaking hinge. A man speaks rapidly in a conversational tone. The video ends with a loud, dramatic orchestral hit stinger.
